name: Night Mode Gaming
author: Flubsound (Flubes & Claude)
description: Play late without waking the house. Auto Level evens every game out and lifts a quiet scene by at most 6 dB, the Startle Guard holds a sudden explosion or burst of gunfire to 20 LU over the ambience before it, firm downward compression evens out the rest while upward compression keeps footsteps, dialogue and quiet details audible, and the deep rumble that travels through walls is reduced. Boost stays low.
